CustomField.description: Lead UI pilot: the Lead's current lifecycle cycle. Blank means the first cycle. Restart at Identify adds one, and while it is above 1 the identity and qualification reviews for the cycle must be confirmed before the Lead moves on or converts. Set by LeadLifecycleCycle_CC only.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Blank for the first pass. Goes up by one each time the Lead is restarted at Identify from Re-Nurture.
CustomField.label: Lifecycle Cycle
